proposed.text: Under SPP 202, what is the source-safe fee rule when the Architect's work is abandoned or suspended in part?

options.text: The Owner pays for services rendered corresponding to the amount due at the stage reached.
The Architect automatically receives more than 100 percent of the fee.
The building official sets the professional fee after abandonment.

proposed.rationale: SPP 202 ties payment to services rendered and the stage reached when work is abandoned or suspended.
